scripts.//build: Declarations only — see tsconfig.build.json. wrangler builds the worker itself; this exists so apps/editor can infer its API client from AppType without compiling the worker's source.
scripts.//build:skill-index: Crawls the allowlisted skills repositories and writes the index to the file named as its argument. Deliberately NOT part of `build` or `deploy`: it reaches the live GitHub API and the thing it produces is published to KV by .github/workflows/build-skill-index.yml, not by a deploy. Takes GITHUB_TOKEN if one is set and runs unauthenticated if not, so it can be run by hand.
